messages.content: amar ekta bhoy ache j ami kokhono kauke enough love korte parbo na properly
Ei bhoy ta kothay theke ashche mone hoy tor?
shayad dekhechi around amake relationship gulo shob fail hote, mone hoy amaro emon hobe

Watching failed relationships around you can absolutely shape that belief, but it's not a prophecy, it's a fear based on limited sample size. Tui nijer capacity niye doubt korchis, naki right person na paoya niye?
mone hoy nijer capacity niye beshi

That fear itself often shows the opposite of what it claims - people who genuinely can't love deeply rarely worry about it this much. Caring this much about doing it right is usually a sign you're capable of it, not incapable.
